proof_coverage.evidence: Right Ore refines middle denominators to prove transitivity; addition and all additive group axioms checked at finite common refinements.
Explicit mutually inverse additive maps [m,s]↔m tensor s^-1; balanced map (m,a s^-1)↦[ma,s] checked independent of fraction presentations.
Exact equivalence [m,s]=0 iff some nonzero a annihilates m on the right; no simultaneous choice of annihilators needed.
Proof preserves monomorphisms, epimorphisms and exact middle terms by one numerator/annihilator/refinement; arbitrary module sizes and no presentation restriction.
Apply proved exactness to cycle/boundary inclusions and quotient sequences degreewise; canonical natural map [z]tensor k↦[z tensor k]. Arbitrary unbounded chain complexes.
Left Ore converts all K elements to t^-1b, so K^op is right fractions over R^op; explicit tensor swap gives left localization, torsion criterion and right flatness.

boundary_checks.disposition: [0,1] is additive zero; fractions with zero numerator are zero with denominator1. Tensor zero module is zero.
S=R-minus-zero contains1 and is multiplicatively closed by absence of zero divisors; every refinement product used remains nonzero.
If R=K, [m,s] corresponds to m s^-1 and the zero criterion reduces to m=0.
Module vanishes after localization iff each element has some nonzero right annihilator, independently for each element; no infinite chosen family.
No PTFA, finite-generation, countability, Noetherian, involution or finite-presentation assumption in generic Statement/proof; only actual right-fraction K presentation is required.
